# Catalog

26 patterns. Each links to its guide; `catalog.json` has the same data for tools and agents.

## Theme level

| Pattern | Summary | Problems solved |
|---|---|---|
| [Author registry](../patterns/theme/author-registry/README.md)<br>`theme/author-registry` | A list of authors kept once in the theme settings, a page field that picks one by ID with options read live from that list, and an author card partial. | 6 |
| [Data layer](../patterns/theme/datalayer/README.md)<br>`theme/datalayer` | A site-agnostic window.dataLayer helper loaded in the head, configured from theme settings through a JSON block, with declarative data-datalayer-event attributes instead of inline scripts. | 3 |
| [Footer columns](../patterns/theme/footer-columns/README.md)<br>`theme/footer-columns` | Footer link columns where each column owns its heading and links, plus an optional trusted-HTML embed column, social links and a note line with {year}. | 6 |
| [Head and body-end scripts](../patterns/theme/head-scripts/README.md)<br>`theme/head-scripts` | Two trusted-HTML theme settings for vendor snippets (analytics, tag managers, chat widgets), rendered in the right place, with a per-page off switch. | 4 |
| [HERE map with conditional loading](../patterns/theme/map-here/README.md)<br>`theme/map-here` | HERE Maps settings in the theme, a loader that adds the map scripts only on pages that show a map, and a map script that reads its settings from JSON and supports linked markers. | 6 |
| [Schema.org graph](../patterns/theme/schema-graph/README.md)<br>`theme/schema-graph` | One linked JSON-LD @graph per page (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, the page, plus BlogPosting and Place when they apply), with site-wide defaults in the theme and a per-page Schema.org tab. | 7 |
| [Site logo](../patterns/theme/site-logo/README.md)<br>`theme/site-logo` | One upload field for the site logo, stored outside the theme folder, with a home-link partial and a URL helper shared with Schema.org output. | 5 |

## Page level

| Pattern | Summary | Problems solved |
|---|---|---|
| [Call-to-action rows](../patterns/page/cta-rows/README.md)<br>`page/cta-rows` | Editor-managed full-width rows, each with a heading, markdown text, an optional image and one button. | 7 |
| [Embeds and page scripts](../patterns/page/embed-block/README.md)<br>`page/embed-block` | Structured fields for third-party embeds (an iframe by URL with a required title and a shape, or a trusted HTML snippet) and page-only scripts, so embed code and Twig stay out of page content. | 4 |
| [Header image](../patterns/page/header-image/README.md)<br>`page/header-image` | A per-page header image with alt text and a show/hide switch, rendered as a responsive, eagerly loaded, high-priority image. | 4 |
| [Hero actions](../patterns/page/hero-actions/README.md)<br>`page/hero-actions` | A primary and an optional secondary button under the page heading, each rendered only when complete. | 2 |
| [Map location](../patterns/page/map-location/README.md)<br>`page/map-location` | Coordinates, a pin title and a summary on any page, so the page appears on Map pages and gets a Place entity in structured data, with no extra markup of its own. | 2 |
| [Page heading and title tag](../patterns/page/page-heading/README.md)<br>`page/page-heading` | Separate SEO title, visible H1, subtitle and byline fields, rendered as an &lt;hgroup&gt; and a &lt;title&gt; element with sensible fallbacks. | 4 |
| [Quick actions (link blocks)](../patterns/page/quick-actions/README.md)<br>`page/quick-actions` | A navigation block of shortcut cards (label, icon, one-line description) in two to four columns. | 4 |
| [Tiles (card grid)](../patterns/page/tiles/README.md)<br>`page/tiles` | An editor-managed grid of cards with widths, icons, markdown text, images, an optional whole-card link and a button, plus a hook for tile types that other templates render. | 7 |

## Page types

| Pattern | Summary | Problems solved |
|---|---|---|
| [Bookable tour or experience](../patterns/page-type/bookable-tour/README.md)<br>`page-type/bookable-tour` | A page type for a tour or experience with a structured weekly schedule, price and availability, ordered stops, a booking widget from page/embed-block, and TouristTrip structured data with an Offer and itinerary. | 5 |
| [Job listing and postings](../patterns/page-type/job-listing/README.md)<br>`page-type/job-listing` | Two page types, a jobs page that lists its open child postings automatically and a job posting with employment type, location, pay, closing date and JobPosting structured data. | 4 |
| [Map page](../patterns/page-type/map-page/README.md)<br>`page-type/map-page` | A page type that pins every page with a Map Location plus optional extra pins, lists the same places under the map with "Show on map" buttons, and outputs them as a Schema.org ItemList. | 5 |
| [Modular page with a general-purpose section](../patterns/page-type/modular-page/README.md)<br>`page-type/modular-page` | A modular parent template that renders its intro and every module with a linkable id, and a general-purpose "section" module built from page/tiles and page/cta-rows. | 3 |

## System level

| Pattern | Summary | Problems solved |
|---|---|---|
| [Plugin settings that work in Admin2](../patterns/system/admin2-plugin-forms/README.md)<br>`system/admin2-plugin-forms` | How a plugin's settings form behaves in Grav 2's Admin2 (an API client that reads saved YAML), and the event wiring that keeps derived or read-only values correct in both Admins. | 5 |
| [Compatibility flag](../patterns/system/compatibility-flag/README.md)<br>`system/compatibility-flag` | Declare the Grav generations a plugin or theme was tested on with compatibility.grav, record the exact versions in a comment, and keep dependencies for minimum versions. | 3 |
| [Dynamic select options (data-options@)](../patterns/system/dynamic-options/README.md)<br>`system/dynamic-options` | Build a select's options from site data with data-options@ and a static provider on the theme or plugin class, registered for Grav 2's provider allowlist. | 4 |
| [Environments and secrets](../patterns/system/environments-and-secrets/README.md)<br>`system/environments-and-secrets` | Use Grav's per-host environment folders for production, staging and local settings, keep salts, keys and accounts out of the repository, and never let local copies talk to live services. | 5 |
| [Front-end output guards for injecting plugins](../patterns/system/frontend-output-guards/README.md)<br>`system/frontend-output-guards` | The checks a plugin should pass before injecting scripts into rendered pages, HTML responses only, privacy signals, and staff accounts in both Grav 1.7 and Grav 2 permission models. | 5 |
| [Twig template hygiene for Grav 2](../patterns/system/template-hygiene/README.md)<br>`system/template-hygiene` | The template rules every pattern here follows, checkable on any theme with `bin/plugin component-library lint <path>`. | 9 |
| [Twig in page content on Grav 2](../patterns/system/twig-in-content/README.md)<br>`system/twig-in-content` | Keep Twig out of page content by moving dynamic parts into header fields and templates; when content Twig is genuinely needed, widen the sandbox narrowly in security.yaml or from a plugin. | 4 |
